message: hermes compile: bare-metal target V_target has no dynamic loader; --link-dynamic is forbidden (got "V_lib"). Use --link-static with a pure C/Rust .a.
why: A bare-metal artifact is firmware: there is no loader at run time to map a .so/.dylib into the address space, so a shared library in the link line can never be honoured. The plan builder keeps DynamicLibs empty on bare metal for exactly this reason — letting one through would produce an artifact that links but cannot start.
fix: replace --link-dynamic with --link-static and give it a pure C/Rust .a
if the library only exists as .so/.dylib, rebuild it as a static archive first (clang -c, then ar rcs)
